data.name: Sghetti Fighter
data.detailed_description:
AVAILABLE TO WISHLIST NOW!

Freddy Sghetti steps up to his own creations in this traditional 2.5D fighting game.

Each character has their own special moves, as well as their own unique stages where cartoon fueled battles take place on land and in the air! String together ground and air combos with special moves for maximum damage!

Freddy brought The Sauce Monsters to life in the comic books, and now they've jumped off the page and onto your screen.

-YardGar the couch surfing cat

-Tommi the EXTRA saucy demon girl

-Sailor Moo the silly silent meat sailor

-Saucera kinda sus' sauce wizard

-Meaty Mike the big-time small-town hero

-Freddy Sghetti the creator himself!

The Sauce Monsters universe goes deep, and once we get the meatball rolling, the characters will keep coming!

data.short_description: A traditional 1v1 indie fighter that takes place in the Sghetti Universe. Play as characters from The Sauce Monsters, and Freddy Sghetti, with more characters coming soon! Combos, air fighting, and special moves make this a fun, strategic game. Play online with friends too!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 / Intel UHD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most modern laptops and desktops
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended for best experience
